items.title: 10.22.2 Paidar energy ke zariye ke taur par photovoltaic cell ki khoobiyan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.22.2, printed page 239.

items: Photovoltaic effect jab tak roshni maujood ho jari rehta hai, jo use bijli banane ka paidar tareeqa banata hai.
Photovoltaic system qabil-e-tajdeed (renewable) energy ka zariya hai jo sooraj ki roshni ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai.
Photovoltaic systems sooraj ki energy istemal karte hain, jo unhen fossil fuels se azad paidar energy ka zariya banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Photovoltaic usool ka hawala dete hue energy ki zaroorat poori karne ke paidar tareeqe ke taur par photovoltaic cells ki khoobiyan bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Kyunke photovoltaic effect ko PN junction ke paar electrons excite karne ke liye sirf roshni chahiye, cell jab tak sooraj chamke bijli banata hai, koi fuel kharch kiye baghair; sooraj ki roshni renewable hai, to supply khatam nahi hoti, aur system ko fossil fuels nahi chahiye, un ke ikhraj aur khatme se bachte hue.

items: Khoobiyan: jab bhi roshni ho kaam karta hai; renewable (sooraj ki roshni); fossil fuels se azad.
